name: Incremental Story Checkpointing
description: Add explicit checkpointing instructions to prompt.md requiring Claude to update PRD status, commit code, and output progress after EACH user story completion - not in batch at the end. Prevents silent marathon sessions where 20+ minutes pass with no visible output or recoverable state.
rationale: During PRD-015 execution on Assumptions Manager, Claude completed all 7 user stories in a 13-minute session but only updated passes: true for all stories at the very end. In YOLO mode, this meant 20 minutes of no visible output. If the session had been killed mid-execution, all work would have been lost with no record of what passed.

userStories.title: Story completion checkpoint protocol in prompt.md
userStories.description: As a developer using FADE, I want prompt.md to instruct Claude to checkpoint after EACH user story, so that I can see incremental progress and recover from interrupted sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: prompt.md includes a 'Story Completion Protocol' section
Protocol requires: 1) Update passes: true immediately after story completion
Protocol requires: 2) Git commit the functional code with appropriate prefix
Protocol requires: 3) Output brief status line: 'US-XXX: [title] ✅'
Protocol explicitly states: 'Do NOT batch status updates'
Protocol explicitly states: 'Checkpoint after every story before proceeding'

userStories.title: YOLO mode observability guidance
userStories.description: As a developer running FADE in YOLO/ALL mode, I want Claude to still output periodic status updates, so that I know work is progressing even without interactive prompts.
acceptanceCriteria: prompt.md includes guidance for autonomous execution modes
Guidance states: 'Even in autonomous/YOLO mode, output status after each story'
Guidance states: 'Never go more than 5 minutes without visible output'
Recommends progress indicator pattern: 'Working on US-XXX... [brief description]'

userStories.title: Acceptance criteria checkpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Claude to mark individual acceptance criteria as they pass (not just the whole story), so that partial progress is captured if a story is interrupted mid-execution.
acceptanceCriteria: prompt.md recommends tracking AC progress within stories
Suggests pattern: Update PRD with 'acPassed': ['AC-1', 'AC-2'] array as criteria are verified
This is OPTIONAL guidance, not mandatory schema change
Rationale documented: enables recovery from mid-story interruptions

implementationNotes.breakingChanges: None - adds guidance only, no schema changes required
implementationNotes.testingApproach: Dogfood on next Assumptions Manager PRD

incidentTrigger.symptom: 20 minutes no output in YOLO mode, all 7 US status updates batched at end
incidentTrigger.impact: No way to know if session was working or hung; no recovery point if killed
